method: Independent process, upstream -rep 1: one discarded warmup plus one measured sample. Linear interpolated quantiles (type 7); sample std n-1; no speed-based exclusions.
limits: Synthetic token id 16, not natural prompt distribution
No TTFT or PSS measured by benchmark
RSS is whole-process maximum, includes warmup/load/tuning
Frequency/thermal samples are before/after, not per-token traces
Fresh process does not imply OS cold file cache
Effective dynamic_option 0 for <=300 prompt tokens, 8 for 512 under fixed requested -dyo 0
